newsitem.title: FINLAND: KEMIRA NAMES NEW PRESIDENT FOR PIGMENTS.
newsitem.headline: KEMIRA NAMES NEW PRESIDENT FOR PIGMENTS.

text.p: Finnish chemicals group Kemira Oy said on Monday it had appointed Risto Keranen president of Kemira Pigments Oy.
"The board of Kemira Pigments Oy has appointed Risto Keranen president from February 1, 1997," Kemira said in a statement.

Keranen will replace Kari Autio, who was appointed director in charge of group business development in Southeast Asia and in central parts of Eastern Europe as well as the group's relations with the European Union, Kemira said.
Keranen joined Kemira in 1984, it said.
